findings.statement: Canonical capacity-role index i can be removed from the common signed exchange carrier under both SIGN and SIGNED_PARITY; roleless signed changed-coordinate counts remain exact.

Under SIGN, exact depth magnitude is unnecessary but depth parity remains required by the common transfer: C_ROLELESS+D_DEPTH_PARITY is exact on all three, while depthless SIGN has one contradiction on 6x3-k3.
Under SIGNED_PARITY, depth parity and exact depth are both removable. C_ROLELESS+D_DEPTHLESS is scalar-exact on all three hard carriers.

The selected compact SIGNED_PARITY realization reduces each pair edge to signed counts over six semantic buckets: C+, C-, D0+, D0-, D1+, D1-, where only odd-magnitude underlying coordinate changes participate.
On 4x5-k4, the SIGNED_PARITY roleless-depthless quotient reduces structural image rank from 282 to 262 with zero scalar loss, exposing a 20-dimensional index-detail kernel.

Depth parity is needed only in the all-sign gauge on 6x3-k3; once even-magnitude coordinate changes are removed by SIGNED_PARITY, depth identity becomes unnecessary. This localizes the residual depth-parity distinction to information carried by even-magnitude changes.

next_question: Can the six signed bucket counts be reduced by presence/parity/ZOE count quotients, and can D0/D1 owner separation be removed?
nonclaims: The six-bucket carrier is not proved globally minimal.
Owner separation is not yet qualified for removal.
Exact signed bucket counts are not yet proved necessary.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
